name: Anointed

open_source.summary: Open-source libraries by Anointed Automation Corporation (MIT): .NET NuGet packages, dotnet new templates, and Sign in with Anointed Automation kits for web, mobile and server stacks. Jesus is King.
open_source.publish_status_note: All Sign in with Anointed Automation kits are published: NuGet, npm, PyPI, Packagist, Maven Central and Swift Package Manager (git tag). The repository llms.json is authoritative for versions.

nuget_packages.description: Algorithms for .NET with no dependencies, starting with a pure C# QR code encoder (ISO/IEC 18004) with Reed-Solomon error correction and automatic version and mask selection.
ASP.NET Core middleware and filters for API key authentication, IP blacklisting, invalid endpoint tracking and idle time memory cleanup.
Models Biblical concepts as .NET types: love as a behavior tree, a moral reality that reads acts against God's character, and an epistemics engine that checks claims for consistency.
Shared enumerations for AnointedAutomation packages: payment types, providers, transaction and subscription statuses, payment operations, card types, webhook events, and moderation categories.
Renders QR codes from AnointedAutomation.Algorithms to SVG and PNG using only the .NET base class library, with no third party image dependency.
A lightweight log message model with severity levels, automatic caller detection and a static LogAdded event for routing logs.
A curated catalog of laws, theories, and conjectures from logic, mathematics, physics, and chemistry, modeled as foundational claims for the AnointedAutomation.Concepts epistemics engine.
On demand garbage collection helper that forces a full collection and tries to return unused memory to the operating system.
Plain POCO models for user accounts, billing and payments, single sign-on identities (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Facebook, Shopify), and standard API response envelopes.
ASP.NET Core helpers: an in memory IFormFile, a hybrid casing System.Text.Json naming convention, and a GraphQL response envelope reader.
Reusable optimization utilities: CSV/DataTable/DataReader helpers, chunking, string helpers, Roman numerals, JSON flattening, file management, and null-safe JsonElement/BsonDocument field accessors.
A MongoDB helper and generic repository base for .NET, with CRUD, paging, aggregation, index management, BSON class maps and casing conventions.
A generic repository and helper for MySQL over Entity Framework Core and the Pomelo provider.

Shared serialization helpers: naming rules (camel, Pascal, snake and the hybrid value/reference casing rule), System.Text.Json casing convention, presets and UTC DateTime converter, tolerant Newtonsoft.Json converters, and lenient JsonElement readers. No MongoDB dependency.

Plain Newtonsoft.Json POCO models for the Shopify Admin REST API (customers, orders, products, fulfillments, inventory, refunds, transactions, webhooks and more), derived from ShopifySharp's REST entities. Models only: no HTTP client, no services, no GraphQL types.

Sign in with Anointed Automation for ASP.NET Core: an OpenID Connect handler preset (authorization code + PKCE S256, verified email only), a back-channel logout endpoint with Logout Token validation and replay protection, and a fail-open session status client.

Front end for Sign in with Anointed Automation in ASP.NET Core: brand-styled sign-in and sign-out buttons as a Tag Helper (Razor Pages, MVC) and Blazor components, plus MapAnointedAutomationAuth() BFF routes (start, sign-out, user info). Cookie only, no tokens in the browser; sign-out also runs RP-initiated logout when the provider publishes end_session_endpoint.

Sign in with Anointed Automation for classic ASP.NET (.NET Framework 4.7.2+, MVC 5 and Web Forms on OWIN/Katana): OpenID Connect middleware preset (code + PKCE S256, verified email only), back-channel logout with Logout Token validation and replay protection, a session status client, and a sign-in button for Razor and Web Forms.

dotnet new templates: anointed-razor (Razor Pages) and anointed-blazor (Blazor Web App, interactive server), wired to AnointedAutomation.SSO and AnointedAutomation.SSO.UI with the client id and secret in user-secrets.

sign_in_kits.description: Sign in with Anointed Automation: a dependency-free, server-only OpenID Connect client (authorization code + PKCE S256, state, nonce, RS256 ID token validation via JWKS) with Express and Web (Next.js App Router, Base44, Workers) adapters.
React companion for Sign in with Anointed Automation: an accessible sign-in button and a useAnointedSignIn hook that navigate the browser to the partner server's start route. No secrets client side.
Next.js App Router start, callback and back-channel logout route handlers built on @anointedautomation/sso.
Vue 3 sign-in button and useAnointedSignIn composable that send the browser to the partner server's start route. No secrets client side.
Nuxt server routes (start, callback, logout, back-channel logout) built on @anointedautomation/sso. Server only.
Angular standalone sign-in button, AnointedSignInService and provideAnointedSignIn() that send the browser to the partner server's start route. No secrets client side.
SvelteKit start, callback, logout and back-channel logout handlers (handle hook or +server.js) built on @anointedautomation/sso, plus a sign-in button (./client).
React Native and Expo sign-in button and useAnointedSignIn hook: open the partner server's start route in a system auth session and read the deep-link callback. No secrets in the app.
Server-side OpenID Connect kit (code + PKCE) for Python with Django, FastAPI/Starlette and Flask adapters, back-channel logout and a session status client.
Sign in with Anointed Automation for PHP and Laravel: code + PKCE S256, ID token verification, logout and back-channel logout.

Sign in with Anointed Automation for iOS and macOS apps: opens the partner's own server start route in ASWebAuthenticationSession; the server (using @anointedautomation/sso) keeps the client secret and redirects back. State check and SwiftUI button included.
Sign in with Anointed Automation for Android 7.0+ (Kotlin, Custom Tabs, Compose button). The app opens the partner's own server start route; the server keeps the client secret.
